title: Add a bounded context
description: Creates one file for a bounded context under project-docs/bounded-contexts/, with structured frontmatter (aliases, disambiguation) and a free-text boundary description. Bootstraps the bounded-contexts/README.md convention doc on first use.

name.description: The canonical name of the bounded context (e.g. "Collision Reporting").
name.x-prompt: What is the bounded context called?

project.description: Scope this bounded context to a specific project's project-docs/bounded-contexts/ instead of the workspace root — prefer this whenever the context already has a natural code home (most often a domain library other projects depend on); only use the workspace root when it genuinely doesn't have one.
